create_Lfm2Config: create an Lfm2Config instance extending HuggingFace Lfm2Config for SGLang hybrid model support
get_full_attention_layer_ids: get the indices of full attention layers for KV cache initialization
get_linear_layer_ids: get the indices of conv and short_conv layers for conv state cache
get_mamba2_cache_params: get Mamba2CacheParams with shape and dtype for HybridReqToTokenPool initialization
override_CONFIG_MAPPING: override CONFIG_MAPPING to register Lfm2Config as the lfm2 config type
